origin.note: all offsets/hitboxes are px relative to origin (feet centre); y down

hover_left.note: airborne base, body 1.4u (52px) above ground; shadow stays at origin

hover_right.note: airborne base, body 1.4u (52px) above ground; shadow stays at origin

hover_down.note: airborne base, body 1.4u (52px) above ground; shadow stays at origin

hover_up.note: airborne base, body 1.4u (52px) above ground; shadow stays at origin

volley_left.note: 3 fireballs, spawn at perFrame mouth, aim along mouthAngleDeg (+ toward player)

volley_right.note: 3 fireballs, spawn at perFrame mouth, aim along mouthAngleDeg (+ toward player)

volley_down.note: 3 fireballs, spawn at perFrame mouth, aim along mouthAngleDeg (+ toward player)

volley_up.note: 3 fireballs, spawn at perFrame mouth, aim along mouthAngleDeg (+ toward player)

t23_left.note: phase 2->3: hit (white), fall, crash f3 (shake + embers), palette swaps to p3 at f4, roar f6-8

t23_right.note: phase 2->3: hit (white), fall, crash f3 (shake + embers), palette swaps to p3 at f4, roar f6-8

t23_down.note: phase 2->3: hit (white), fall, crash f3 (shake + embers), palette swaps to p3 at f4, roar f6-8

t23_up.note: phase 2->3: hit (white), fall, crash f3 (shake + embers), palette swaps to p3 at f4, roar f6-8

hurtbox.note: body hurtbox, bottom on feet; P2 hover: raise by the hover height (52 px) with the body

claw.note: R claw hits f2, L claw hits f4

tail.note: 360 deg spin; tail blade sweeps behind and in front

t12.note: phase 1->2: leap into hover; invulnerable; ends in hover

hover.note: airborne base, body 1.4u (52px) above ground; shadow stays at origin

volley.note: 3 fireballs, spawn at perFrame mouth, aim along mouthAngleDeg (+ toward player)

t23.note: phase 2->3: hit (white), fall, crash f3 (shake + embers), palette swaps to p3 at f4, roar f6-8

dive.fx: shockwave at perFrame shockwaveSpawn, expands both ways; impact+embers

meteor.fx: meteor spawned off-screen top above target, impact on landing (game decides targets)

molten.fx: breath_loop tinted/scaled, rotate to mouthAngleDeg each frame (sweep forward->ground)

firebreath.fx: fire_start@4, fire_loop@5-8 (repeat as needed), fire_end@9; mouth/angle per frame in attacks.json mouthData
firebreath.note: dedicated phase-1 fire breath: inhale/rear-back 0-3, lunge 4, loopable hold 5-8 (repeat 5-8 for longer fire), surge 9, recovery 10-13. Mouth glow baked into frames 1-10.

mouthData._doc: per-frame mouth point (x,y) in 640x512 frame pixels from the frame top-left; origin (320,400). angleDeg = breath direction, screen space, 0=+x (right), +90=down (y grows down). Directions: left,right,down,up (up = walking away, mouth hidden behind head; point still given). Up/down angles are fixed at -90/+90 (the projected head axis is degenerate in those views).
